acceptance.control: An identical retained frame must agree with and without the legacy color pre-resize.
acceptance.decision: A mismatch of verification, motion direction or normalized displacement rejects the legacy pre-resize. The controller-owned transform becomes the only admissible comparison path.

hypothesis: The controller and the experimental quiet-window observer must use the same controller-owned visual transform before a physical result can qualify a return policy.
outcome: The legacy color pre-resize selected different feature correspondences on fifteen real adjacent pairs. The experimental adapter now passes original frames to the production matcher, which owns the canonical grayscale normalization.
title: Consistência do comparador entre escala de captura e escala de controle
